decisions.reason: Because it remained on the website into 2024 and builds directly on the firm's established spraying business, we judge its results as at least close to aspiration and worth retaining.
Its dedicated product pages in both years and the reported field-test use suggest satisfactory early market validation for a close-to-core product, so we would keep it.
A multi-model line using proven existing air-motor technology fits the firm's capabilities well and likely benefits from acceptable performance and low incremental risk, so we would keep it.

We would keep it because it still had its own page in 2024 and supports the firm's move toward more digital and interoperable customer solutions, even if it is somewhat more adjacent than the pump products.

As the newest launch it has the most uncertainty and shortest performance record, but its closeness to the core offer and the firm's innovative slack in a growing industry argue for continued support rather than an early withdrawal.
